title: CRM event envelope v1
description: The complete Kafka message value for topic crm.events.v1. Exactly twelve fields (frozen Sprint 0001 decision). event_id MUST equal outbox_event.id (database-contract.md section 5, ratified invariant). schema_version is the major version of the payload schema for this event_type; it selects the payload schema file (e.g. interaction.logged + 1 -> interaction-logged.v1.schema.json). Validators MUST evaluate this schema with draft 2020-12 format assertion enabled (e.g. Ajv strict + ajv-formats in assertion mode); format-as-annotation does not satisfy the contract (event-contract.md section 3.4). Contract: docs/specs/event-contract.md.

event_id.description: Globally unique event identity. MUST equal outbox_event.id.

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant. MUST equal outbox_event.tenant_id. Also the Kafka partition key.

event_type.description: Domain event name, <aggregate>.<past-tense-verb>, e.g. interaction.logged. MUST equal outbox_event.event_type.

aggregate_type.description: Logical domain object the event is about, e.g. interaction. MUST equal outbox_event.aggregate_type.

aggregate_id.description: Identifier of the aggregate row, e.g. interaction.id. MUST equal outbox_event.aggregate_id.

aggregate_version.description: Version of the aggregate at emission; 1 for append-only interactions in this slice. MUST equal outbox_event.aggregate_version.

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the business fact (for interaction.logged: the server-assigned interaction.occurred_at). A business timestamp, not a delivery-order guarantee.

actor_id.description: user_id of the acting user; provably a member of tenant_id via the database contract's composite actor FKs and withTenantWrite recheck.

schema_version.description: Major version of the payload schema for this event_type; scoped per event_type; 1 in this slice.

correlation_id.description: Identifies the causal chain; minted by the API once per HTTP request and carried by every event that request stages.

causation_id.description: event_id of the direct causal predecessor event, or null when the event originates directly from a user action. Always null in Sprint 0001.

payload.description: Event-type-specific body, validated against the schema selected by (event_type, schema_version).
